variants.name: dread-cowl
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is Hex Votary edit target and binding Runelord style reference. Create one full-body variation of this same red-skinned horned demon curse caster, same serious angular 2D cel shading, broad flat colors, crisp graphic shadows and refined readable finish. Transparent background. Robes ONLY: folded cloth, no armor, no metal shoulder plates. Sinister and demonic, not human wizard. Red face, charcoal horns, predatory features, hooked nails, black and oxblood robes, controlled glowing infernal glyphs on staff/focus. Full character and staff inside canvas with margin. No text or scene. Preserve original proportions and detail density, quiet cloth surfaces, avoid photorealism and dense tiny ornament. Variant A: Dread Cowl. Deep oversized black pointed hood splits around two swept-back horns, face half-submerged in shadow with narrow ember eyes and exposed red jaw. Mantle made of overlapping hooked CLOTH panels like bat wings, deep wine-red lining, long split hanging sleeves and severe tapered robe hem. Jagged rune stave held upright and free claw raised in curse sign. Cloth silhouette heavy at shoulders narrowing toward ankles; no armor.
